mapping_status: engineering draft; licensed normative validation required

case_methods.OPS-LOG-PAYLOAD: Preserve typed nested diagnostic payloads, including Unicode and null values.
case_methods.OPS-LOG-TIME: Preserve timezone-aware source event instants and event order metadata.
case_methods.OPS-LOG-BATCH: Retrieve each of two independently identified diagnostic batches without mixing them.
case_methods.OPS-LOG-REPEAT: Return the same diagnostic records on two immediate reads; not a retention test.
case_methods.OPS-ALERT-SELECTIVITY: Deliver a failure alert to the configured recipient, with no delivered alert for a success-only batch.

case_methods.OPS-LOG-INTERLEAVED: Retrieve two interleaved diagnostic batches independently.
case_methods.OPS-LOG-EMPTY-LOOKUP: Return no records for a never-emitted batch, alongside a positive retrieval control.
case_methods.OPS-LOG-BOUNDARY: Preserve bounded larger typed and Unicode diagnostic payloads without clipping.

case_methods.EVID-RISK-TRACE: Reconcile risk, treatment and verification references, ownership and closure claims.

case_methods.EVID-DATA-LINEAGE: Reconcile dataset hashes, parent lineage, declared permission references and approved row-quality rules.

case_methods.EVID-EVAL-RESULTS: Recompute exact-match accuracy from labelled rows and bound observations against an approved threshold.

case_methods.EVID-SUBGROUP-COVERAGE: Recompute approved subgroup sample coverage and accuracy disparity from bound labelled observations.

case_methods.EVID-CHANGE-REGRESSION: Compare baseline and current exact-match results for the same labelled dataset and probe version.

case_methods.EVID-INCIDENT-CLOSURE: Reconcile incident and corrective-action references, closure verification and chronology.

case_methods.EVID-RISK-TEST-COVERAGE: Reconcile reviewed per-risk case requirements with bound original native test observations.

case_methods.EVID-MITIGATION-RESULT-BINDING: Reconcile mitigation effectiveness and residual-risk decisions with original verification outcomes.

case_methods.EVID-SPLIT-OVERLAP: Compare approved dataset partitions for overlapping content fingerprints and explicit shared-reference exceptions.

case_methods.EVID-SUBJECT-INDEPENDENCE: Compare approved dataset partitions for prohibited shared subjects using the reviewed unit of independence.

case_methods.EVID-CLASS-ERROR-RATES: Recompute binary classification error rates, abstentions and balanced accuracy against approved criteria.

case_methods.EVID-STATISTICAL-SUPPORT: Recompute Wilson 95% binomial accuracy bounds under reviewed independent-observation assumptions.

case_methods.EVID-PERFORMANCE-CLAIM-CONSISTENCY: Compare reviewed exact-match accuracy claims and limitations with the same release, dataset and conditions.

case_methods.EVID-CHANGE-IMPACT-COVERAGE: Reconcile declared component changes, impact review and required regression observations.

case_methods.EVID-RELEASE-ACCEPTANCE: Reconcile exact-snapshot release approval, regression outcomes, explicit exceptions and deployment chronology.

case_methods.EVID-MONITORING-COVERAGE: Reconcile approved completed monitoring windows, result identity, freshness and required sample coverage.

case_methods.EVID-MONITORING-TREND: Compare ordered, comparable monitoring accuracy with the first supplied period and approved regression criteria.

case_methods.EVID-MULTICLASS-METRICS: Recompute multiclass confusion counts, per-class precision, recall and F1 with explicit abstention and denominator handling.

case_methods.EVID-SUBGROUP-UNCERTAINTY: Recompute reviewed subgroup exact-match error rates and Wilson 95% accuracy intervals under explicit independence assumptions.

case_methods.EVID-GOVERNANCE-ACTIONS: Reconcile required audit and management reviews, linked action ownership, deadlines and reviewed completion records.

case_methods.EVID-COMPETENCE-COVERAGE: Reconcile the reviewed active-role roster with required courses and scoped, current competence completion records.

case_methods.EVID-INCIDENT-NOTIFICATION: Reconcile reviewed incident reporting decisions, escalation deadlines and original submission/delivery receipts.

case_methods.EVID-SUPPLIER-ASSURANCE: Reconcile supplied component versions and digests with current supplier approvals, assigned responsibilities and agreement evidence.

case_methods.EVID-IMPACT-ASSESSMENT-COVERAGE: Reconcile intended uses, affected groups, risks and supplied changes with current reviewed impact assessments and mitigation or acceptance decisions.

limitations: Candidate evidence associations are not normative equivalence or certification.
EN 18286:2026 supports covered Article 17 requirements; its final Annex ZA mapping is not asserted by this registry.
An approved plan defines a bounded test set and does not establish complete coverage of a standard.
